content_blocks.label: clause_1._TERM_AND_RENT
content_blocks.text: The term of the Lease shall commence on November 1, 2024, and continue for a period of twelve (12) months.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_PROPERTY_DESCRIPTION
content_blocks.text: The Property hereunder referred to as 'Premises' is described as 123 Maple Street, Springfield Township, State of Novaria.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._REPAIRS_AND_MAINTENANCE
content_blocks.text: The Landlord shall maintain the Premises in good repair and condition, subject to normal wear and tear.
